recognize_zh: 中倍抹片下大量芽細胞取代骨髓：細胞大小相近、核圓、染色質細緻、胞質少而嗜鹼性，只零星看到幾個分葉嗜中性球與小淋巴球，缺乏成熟中的顆粒球系細胞，符合 AML without maturation。
features: Marked predominance of blasts replacing normal marrow elements
Medium to large blasts with round to oval nuclei and fine chromatin
High N:C ratio with scant basophilic, mostly agranular cytoplasm
Only rare segmented neutrophils and small lymphocytes; maturing myeloid precursors virtually absent
Few erythroid precursors; scattered fat vacuoles in background
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear at medium power shows marked replacement by a relatively uniform population of blasts with round to oval nuclei, fine chromatin, high N:C ratio, and scant basophilic, largely agranular cytoplasm. Maturing granulocytic precursors are scarce, with only rare segmented neutrophils, small lymphocytes, and erythroid precursors. Auer rods are not evident at this magnification. Findings are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia without maturation, pending cytochemistry (MPO ≥3% of blasts) and flow cytometric confirmation.

ddx.vs: Morphology can overlap; ALL blasts are MPO-negative and express B- or T-lymphoid markers on flow cytometry.
Would show ≥10% promyelocytes, myelocytes, and neutrophils, whereas maturing granulocytic cells are sparse here.
Indistinguishable on Wright stain; it requires <3% MPO/SBB-positive blasts with myeloid antigens by flow.
Erythroid blasts have deeply basophilic, often vacuolated cytoplasm and are E-cadherin/CD71 positive and MPO negative.
